properties.headline: Special Weather Statement issued August 12 at 8:35PM MDT by NWS Denver CO
properties.description:
At 835 PM MDT, Doppler radar was tracking a strong thunderstorm 5
miles east of Paoli, or 5 miles west of Holyoke, moving northeast at
20 mph.

HAZARD...Wind gusts up to 50 mph and penny size hail.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Gusty winds could knock down tree limbs and blow around
unsecured objects. Minor damage to outdoor objects is
possible.

Locations impacted include...
Holyoke, Paoli, Sixteen-Mile Corner and Amherst.

properties.headline: Flash Flood Warning issued August 12 at 6:39PM MDT until August 12 at 9:15PM MDT by NWS Grand Junction CO
properties.description:
FFWGJT

The National Weather Service in Grand Junction has issued a

* Flash Flood Warning for...
The Elk RBX burn scar in...
Eastern Rio Blanco County in northwestern Colorado...

* Until 915 PM MDT.

* At 639 PM MDT, Doppler radar indicated thunderstorms producing
heavy rain over the Elk RBX Burn Scar. Between 0.3 and 0.6 inches
of rain have fallen. The expected rainfall rate is 1.8 to 2.5
inches in 1 hour. Flash flooding is ongoing or expected to begin
shortly. Excessive rainfall over the burn scar will result in
debris flow. The debris flow can consist of rock, mud, vegetation
and other loose materials.

HAZARD...Life threatening flash flooding. Thunderstorms producing
flash flooding in and around the Elk RBX Burn Scar.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Life threatening flash flooding of areas in and around the
Elk RBX Burn Scar.

* Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
Mainly rural areas of Eastern Rio Blanco County.

properties.headline: Flood Advisory issued August 12 at 6:09PM MDT until August 12 at 9:15PM MDT by NWS Denver CO
properties.description:
* WHAT...Flooding caused by excessive rainfall is expected.

* WHERE...Northwestern Logan County in northeastern Colorado...

* WHEN...Until 915 PM MDT.

* IMPACTS...Minor flooding in low-lying and poor drainage areas.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...

- At 609 PM MDT, Doppler radar indicated heavy rain due to
thunderstorms. Minor flooding is ongoing or expected to begin
shortly in the advisory area. Between 1.5 and 2 inches of rain
have fallen.

- Additional rainfall amounts up to 0.5 inches are expected over
the area. This additional rain will result in minor flooding.

- Some locations that will experience flooding include...
Westplains.
